provenance: Data-derived from Koenig DCM single-nucleus RNA-seq (GSE183852, 220,752 nuclei). Genes with cardiomyocyte pseudobulk CPM >= 300 and cardiomyocyte/max-other-cell-type specificity >= 10x, excluding OXPHOS and MT- genes. This deliberately drops broadly-expressed abundant sarcomere genes (MYL2/MYL3/MYH7/TTN/MYH6) that co-vary with metabolic state and would over-attribute the effect, keeping only true CM-restricted ambient tracers. Used to quantify cardiomyocyte ambient contamination in non-cardiomyocyte cell types (e.g. endothelial nuclei) as a percent.mito-style score. NOTE: a few entries (RP11-532N4.2, RP11-368L12.1, HRAT17) are clone/locus identifiers that may not harmonise to HGNC symbols in other datasets; unmatched genes simply contribute 0 to the score.
